blocks.value: Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming methodology built around objects whose behaviors and interactions accomplish a task.
An object has attributes (characteristics), and the current values of those attributes give it a state. The actions an object can perform are its behaviors, and each behavior is defined by a method.
Objects of the same kind share a data type and belong to the same class. A class is the blueprint that defines what an object looks like. Its data type is the name of the class that created it.
